TrialYard 1.1.0 moves to Selkies 2.0 on a pinned base.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Built on Selkies 2.0, pinned by digest.** The base is pinned to one ubunturesolute build, so a builder that still holds an older ubunturesolute cannot quietly produce an image on the previous Selkies.
- **The screen follows your browser window.** The X server no longer reserves a 530 MB framebuffer up front; a fresh container idles at about 160 MB.
- **Desktop OpenGL renders in software.** On the Selkies 2.0 base the Zink driver can no longer present windows on an NVIDIA GPU, so the override is gone and applications fall back to llvmpipe. Video encoding stays on NVENC.
- **An empty password still means no login.** The base now treats an empty `PASSWORD` field as unset, so this image's own workaround for it is gone.
